stories.title: In pensione sempre più tardi, nel 2029 a 67 anni e mezzo

en.title: Retirement age rising ever later, 67 and a half in 2029
en.summary: Italy's retirement age is increasing, reaching 67.5 years in 2029 and 67 years 8 months by 2031. Pension spending is growing as the number of workers fails to offset new retirees, projected to reach 17.1% of GDP by 2041.

stories.title: La premier attacca Istat e Giorgetti: “Incredibile sia andata a finire così”

en.title: Premier attacks Istat and Giorgetti: "Incredible how it ended up this way"
en.summary: Italy's premier criticized officials regarding fiscal matters. The Treasury claims Italy achieved the best deficit result among major countries.

stories.title: Trump dilaga all'ONU, minacce a Iran e Cuba: "Altri parlano di pace, io la faccio"

en.title: Trump dominates at UN, threatens Iran and Cuba: "Others talk of peace, I make it"
en.summary: The U.S. president delivered an extended UN address with warnings toward Iran and Cuba. He subsequently met with Zelensky and signed a military agreement regarding Greenland.

stories.title: Meloni con l’elmetto in modalità elettorale: la sfida finale è al Colle

en.title: Meloni in campaign mode with helmet: the final challenge is at the Colle
en.summary: The Italian prime minister engaged in campaign activities amid discussion of a document signed 36 years ago by a former minister, circulated through parliamentary chat groups.

stories.title: Conti, gelata sul governo. Il deficit resta sopra il 3%. E la premier attacca l’Istat

en.title: Conti, gelata sul governo. Il deficit resta sopra il 3%. E la premier attacca l'Istat
en.summary: Italy's deficit remains above 3 percent, keeping the country under an infringement procedure. The premier has criticized the national statistics institute over the figures.

stories.title: Trump alle Nazioni Unite: “Porto la pace nel mondo, ora l’accordo con l’Iran”

en.title: Trump at the United Nations: "I bring peace to the world, now the agreement with Iran"
en.summary: At the UN General Assembly, Trump called for Putin to reach an agreement with Ukraine and discussed his administration's approach to international peace. He also referred to artificial intelligence as "superintelligence."

stories.title: Zelensky spera nell’aiuto della Cina: “Stop alle armi prima dell’inverno”

en.title: Zelensky hopes for China's help: "Stop weapons before winter"
en.summary: The Ukrainian president met with Trump at the UN General Assembly to discuss a potential energy truce and pathways to end the war in Ukraine.

stories.title: Vannacci, le donne senza gonne e quel confine sottile chiamato civiltà

en.title: Vannacci, women without skirts and that thin line called civilization
en.summary: The general has made controversial statements that pushed boundaries of acceptable speech, with each instance moving further than the previous one.

stories.title: Meloni a 'Cinque Minuti' e 'Porta a Porta': "Scuola, Mattarella vuole superare i ghetti"

en.title: Meloni on 'Cinque Minuti' and 'Porta a Porta': "School, Mattarella wants to overcome ghettos"
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni discussed key national issues in interviews, including a 30% cap on foreign students, deficit concerns, tensions with Vannacci, wages, and criticism of opposition parties.

stories.title: Scuola, Meloni attacca Mattarella: “Da ministro voleva il tetto per gli stranieri in classe”

en.title: School, Meloni attacks Mattarella: "As minister he wanted a cap on foreign students in class"
en.summary: The Prime Minister referenced the President regarding past circulars on student caps, an issue from 1990, while opposition leaders criticized her statement as lacking respect for state institutions.

stories.title: Ai, l’appello dell’Onu a Usa e Cina: “Cooperate prima che sia tardi”

en.title: UN appeals to USA and China: "Cooperate before it's too late" on AI
en.summary: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres calls on the United States and China to establish emergency mechanisms to address artificial intelligence, which he characterizes as a threat comparable to war and climate change. Trump expresses skepticism about regulatory frameworks.

stories.title: Stranieri in classe, Meloni sfida Mattarella: “Da ministro fece come me”. Lo stupore del Colle

en.title: Foreign students in class, Meloni challenges Mattarella: "As minister I did the same". The Quirinal's surprise
en.summary: Prime Minister Meloni cites a 36-year-old text to defend her position on foreign students in schools, referencing actions by the current President when he held ministerial office. The Presidential office expressed surprise at the comparison.

stories.title: Procedure di estinzione, in rialzo le richieste di chi non ha nulla

en.title: Extinction procedures, requests rising from those with nothing
en.summary: Applications for debt relief from individuals with no assets have surged by 630 percent over a five-year period.

stories.title: Siderurgia: Federacciai, con caro energia a rischio continuità produttiva

en.title: Steel industry: Federacciai, energy costs risk production continuity
en.summary: Rising electricity and gas prices threaten the operational continuity of Italian energy-intensive industries, particularly steel manufacturers.

stories.title: Media, un articolo su cinque propone un’immagine negativa del Mezzogiorno

en.title: Media, one article in five presents a negative image of Southern Italy
en.summary: Research findings show that approximately one-fifth of media articles adopt a negative tone when reporting on Southern Italy, reflecting patterns in journalistic coverage of the region.

stories.title: Eventi dal vivo, la milanese Superstudio conquista Manhattan

en.title: Live events, Milan-based Superstudio conquers Manhattan
en.summary: Superstudio acquired a majority stake in Spring Studios New York and launched global expansion plans targeting 240 million dollars in revenue over five years.

stories.title: Europa attraente per investire, l’Italia batte Spagna e Svizzera

en.title: Europe attractive for investment, Italy beats Spain and Switzerland
en.summary: Europe ranks as the top destination for non-European business investment and corporate ventures, with Italy performing better than Spain and Switzerland among European countries.
